result.summary: Found 3 visual issues: a major low-contrast promo banner, horizontal content clipping at the right edge, and truncated restaurant/card text that hurts scannability.

issues.description: The promotional banner text (“3 free deliveries for you” and the code/subtext) is washed out white on a pale mint background with very poor contrast, making it hard to read.
issues.suggestion: Darken the text color or increase banner contrast/overlay so heading, terms, and CTA meet WCAG contrast guidelines.

issues.description: Right-edge items appear abruptly clipped: the category chips after “Healthy” and the “Fastest near you” card for Trattoria Piccol… are cut off without enough visual affordance.
issues.suggestion: Add clearer horizontal-scroll affordance, padding at the viewport edge, or fade/gradient to indicate more content instead of hard clipping.

issues.description: Restaurant names/labels are truncated in the horizontally scrolling section, e.g. “Trattoria Piccol…”, reducing readability.
issues.suggestion: Allow wider cards, reduce card count per row, or use marquee/tooltip/full name on tap while keeping truncation consistent.
